operations.name: LU Decomposition
operations.description: LU factorisation of 500×500 matrix (pure Numba PLU; scipy unavailable in @njit)

operations.name: Eigenvalue Decomp
operations.description: Full eigendecomposition of 300×300 symmetric matrix (@njit → np.linalg.eigh)

operations.name: Cholesky
operations.description: Cholesky factorisation of 500×500 SPD matrix (@njit → np.linalg.cholesky)

operations.name: SVD
operations.description: Economy SVD of 500×300 matrix (@njit → np.linalg.svd; U:500×300)

operations.name: Linear System Solve
operations.description: Solve Ax=b for 1000×1000 A, 1000 b (@njit → np.linalg.solve)

operations.name: Vector Dot Product
operations.description: Dot product of two 10M-element vectors (@njit → BLAS ddot)

operations.name: Hadamard Product
operations.description: Element-wise multiply + add on 1000×1000 matrices (@njit parallel prange)

operations.name: FFT (real, 1M)
operations.description: Real FFT of 2²⁰=1M-element vector (@njit → np.fft.rfft; requires Numba ≥0.55)

operations.name: Sort 10M floats
operations.description: Unstable sort of 10M random float64 values (@njit → np.sort)
